'හන්' යන වාසගමින් තමා හඳුන්වා දුන් මෙම අපේක්ෂකයා, යූටියුබ් හරහා නිකුත් කළ වීඩියෝවකින් මේ බව තහවුරු කළේය. මුහුණු ආවරණයක් පැළඳ සිටි ඔහු, තමන් විද්‍යුත් උපකරණ සහ 'generative AI' තාක්ෂණය යොදාගනිමින් මෙම වංචාව සිදුකළ බවත්, තම සමත් වීම සාධාරණ උත්සාහයක ප්‍රතිඵලයක් නොවන බවත් පවසමින් සමාව අයැද සිටියේය.පසුගි

item.description: Nearly 30 years since the project was first mooted, the National Single Window for Trade, an online portal intended to replace duplicated paper filings to Customs, quarantine, port and other agencies with a single submission, went live this week with two export sectors admitted and no timetable published for the rest.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] SEC says Budget 2027 will boost capital market
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka (SEC) has welcomed the 2027 Budget, saying the adoption of two of its long-advocated proposals, “A Share for Everyone” and the SME Listing Support Mechanism, will deepen the capital market and broaden investor participation.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Institutional analysts say Budget 2027 broadly toes fiscal line, warn of post-IMF tests
item.description: Budget 2027, presented by President and Finance Minister Anura Kumara Dissanayake on 12 November, keeps the country on its fiscal consolidation path, with a primary surplus that just meets the International Monetary Fund (IMF) target.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Tourism earnings rise for third consecutive month in October, but 10-month revenue remains down 8.3%
item.description: Sri Lanka’s tourism earnings registered a third consecutive monthly increase in October, rising 3.5% year-on-year (YoY) to $ 192.7 million, after recording its highest-ever monthly tourist arrivals during the month, welcoming 168,625 visitors as demand strengthened ahead of the winter season, according to the latest data released by the Central Bank.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] People’s Bank sustains strong earnings momentum
item.description: People’s Bank has delivered a strong financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, building on its earnings momentum and demonstrating financial resilience in an evolving global and domestic economic environment.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Treasury moves to cut six months off project delays
item.description: The Government has changed the way State institutions buy goods, works, and services. They can now complete most of the procurement process for next year’s projects before Parliament passes the Budget, a change the Treasury says will save six months in project delivery.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Cabinet approves household composting initiative in Western and Southern Provinces
